name: magentix-marketplace
description: Self-hosting one-plugin marketplace for Magentix, an adoption engine that compiles best-practice blueprints and situated profiles into working agent artifacts.

plugins.name: magentix
plugins.description: Adopts best-practice blueprints against a person's or a project's actual situation and compiles them into working artifacts, with skills for the full adoption loop and subagents for read-only project surveying and spec validation.
